svg.title: 从玩家活跃到经营贡献 / From player activity to operating contribution
svg.desc: Framework illustration. Not historical company data or a universal organization chart.
svg.text: FIGURE 04 · JOYCE MI / 艾小米 · GLOBAL GAME COPILOT
从玩家活跃到经营贡献
From player activity to operating contribution
DAU = 新增活跃 + 留存活跃 + 回流活跃
DAU = new + retained + reactivated active players
分组互斥；同一日、同一产品、同一口径 / Mutually exclusive groups, same day and scope
日毛收入 = DAU × 当日毛收入 ARPDAU
Daily gross revenue = DAU × gross-revenue ARPDAU
ARPDAU分母为全部DAU；不要混用付费用户客单价 / Denominator: all DAU, not only payers
净收入 = 毛收入 − 渠道费用、退款等扣减
Net revenue = gross revenue − defined deductions
税费与扣减依渠道、地区和记账口径核对 / Check channel, market and accounting definitions
经营贡献 = 净收入 − 获客支出 − 运营成本
Operating contribution = net revenue − acquisition − operating costs
不是公司最终净利润；需列明未纳入的成本 / Not company net profit; disclose excluded costs
变量关系示意；没有使用真实项目收入或玩家数据。 / Symbolic model; no historical revenue or player data.
